arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-30' AND date < '2019-10-31'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated 30 October 2019, treated as "yesterday" relative to the last day of the data.
assumptions: 'Yesterday' is resolved against the last day of the data (2019-10-31), so it means 2019-10-30.
The count includes all transactions, labelled or not, and any amount sign.
